newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ice avalanche kills four more in Swiss Alps.
newsitem.headline: Ice avalanche kills four more in Swiss Alps.

text.p: An ice avalanche toppled four climbers to their deaths on a glacier in southern Switzerland on Tuesday, raising the toll among visitors in the Swiss Alps to at least 43 since mid-July.
Police said falling ice from the Taeschhorn, a mountain near the Matterhorn on the Swiss-Italian border, hit the four people as they climbed the mountain roped together.
They fell 360 metres onto a glacier. The bodies had been spotted but not yet recovered so nothing was immediately known about their identities, police said.
A combination of snow, heat and thunderstorms has made high-altitude climbing treacherous during the summer tourist season.
